item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://www.onshape.com/en/blog/ai-generated-thumbnail-description-search","version_id":"b2755a997c3cdda71421bbdd40ee9721d353cbc20ed2f1f80e91169757b9bbd2","decision":"accept","reason":"This is a fresh, directly relevant commercial CAD item: Onshape says its opt-in Labs feature generates searchable descriptions from model thumbnails, enabling natural-language retrieval such as “red bracket.” The cited, checkable scope is limited to public documents and thumbnail-derived visual descriptions; it does not establish that search results are geometrically correct, suitable for manufacture, or that reuse and duplicate-design reduction occur in practice.
